assessment.result: Existing authorRegistry appropriately shares pinned raw registry parsing, normalized ID/Unicode/duplicate-key checks and exclusive publisher. Ordered RegistryColumns is necessary data rather than a mutation-map overload. The scalar switch and short quote loop directly express the selected CSV contract; Go csv.Writer cannot preserve the required byte semantics with UseCRLF. No new function/helper/closure/type/dependency/writer; no gratuitous new abstraction found.

Numeric ID sorting preserves source ID spelling. Missing/null/false/integer-zero become empty; true emits True; math/big preserves arbitrary integer precision. Selected strings preserve text and paired Unicode, while floats/arrays/objects explicitly refuse. Unselected opaque metadata remains ignored. Header/body quoting doubles quotes, quotes comma/CR/LF and single empty cells, writes CRLF records and preserves embedded CR/LF, leading whitespace and literal backslash-dot.

Five-field explicit recipe and ordered-column guards reject update/date/image fields; foreign RegistryColumns refuses in plan/planBundle/references/other registry operations and strict inspect schemas. Export skips mutation and last_updated rewriting, rehashes/rechecks source, previews only JSON and applies through unchanged writeNewFile. Existing-operation branches retain their semantics; complete existing CLI owner passes.

independent_probes.per_positive: Preview and apply output hash/whole bytes match independently frozen Python stdlib csv.writer expectation; five overwrite/source/profile/symlink/hardlink aliases refuse with empty stdout.
independent_probes.inputs: All source/profile bytes and source inode/mtime preserved.
positive_cases: Unusual Unicode/comma/quote/CRLF column names; NUL, NBSP, emoji, combining text, embedded CR/LF, literal backslash-dot, leading whitespace, formula text, true/false/zero/large negative integer; numeric ID order and source spelling
Single selected empty/null/NUL column including required single-empty-cell quoting
Unselected opaque nested duplicate keys and lone surrogate remain unread metadata

limits: Focused ordinary review only; no full suite/race, exhaustive type/performance/concurrency campaign or family completion claim.
Flat registry-plan CSV projection only: no status counts, glossary/flow report, installed disc truth, spreadsheet formula escaping or historical retirement claim.
No production/test/doc changes; no original project Python executed/imported, ISO/canonical registry/emulator/process/PINE/controller/settings access. Reviewer supplies findings, not approval.
